title: An improved lower bound on the Banach--Mazur distance to the cross-polytope
summary: Let $Γ$ be an $n\times m$ matrix with independent standard Gaussian entries and let $G_m = Γ(B_1^m)$ be the associated Gaussian Gluskin polytope (equivalently, a random $n$-dimensional quotient of $\ell_1^m$). In the regime $m = n^3$ we prove that, with probability at least $1-2/n$, $$ d_{\mathrm{BM}}(G_m,B_1^n) \ge c n^{4/7}(\log n)^{-C}, $$ where $B_1^n = \conv\{\pm e_1,\dots,\pm e_n\}$ is the cross-polytope.
